title: Optimize processes
intro: An analysis task reads usage, audit, operations and metrics of the workgroups you may read and proposes improvements. It changes nothing.
visibility.org: The report is visible to all members of the workgroup {name} and may contain totals of all workgroups you can read.
visibility.wg: The report is visible to all members of the workgroup {name}.
error.peer_outdated: The analysis cannot start yet: every device of the organization must be updated first.
profile.locked: An analysis task always reads only; start an ordinary task to change something.
adopt.title: Adopt into a whiteboard
adopt.visibility.org: The report is visible to all members of the organization and may contain totals of all workgroups you can read.
orchestrator: A session of an analysis task cannot become your main orchestrator: it only reads.
